text: Naku chala stress ga undhi, emi cheyalo teliyadam ledu
translation_en: I am feeling very stressed, don't know what to do

text: Erooju nenu chala happy ga unnanu, work baga jarigindhi
translation_en: Today I am very happy, work went really well

text: Nobody cares about me, nenu chala lonely ga feel avutunnanu
translation_en: Nobody cares about me, I feel very lonely

text: Naku chala anxiety vundhi exam gurinchi
translation_en: I have so much anxiety about the exam

text: Aaj mujhe bohot stress ho raha hai, hopeless lag raha hai
translation_en: I am feeling very stressed today, feeling hopeless

text: Aap se baat karke bohot accha laga, feeling hopeful now
translation_en: Felt very good talking to you, feeling hopeful now

text: Mujhe bohot gussa aa raha hai, frustrated hu main
translation_en: I am feeling so angry, I am frustrated

text: Main akela feel kar raha hu, koi nahi hai mere saath
translation_en: I am feeling alone, there is nobody with me

text: Me siento tan anxious y cansado por todo el trabajo
translation_en: I feel so anxious and tired from all the work

text: Estoy super excited por el viaje de mañana!
translation_en: I am super excited for tomorrow's trip!

text: No me siento bien, me siento solo y sad hoy
translation_en: I don't feel good, I feel lonely and sad today

text: Enaku romba stress ah iruku, padika mudiyala
translation_en: I am feeling very stressed, unable to study

text: Iniku naan romba happy ah iruken, semma day!
translation_en: I am very happy today, awesome day!
